newsitem.title: UK: C&W says working on German alliance.
newsitem.headline: C&W says working on German alliance.

text.p: Cable and Wireless, responding to a report in the London Financial Times on Saturday, said it was working on plans to bring German utility company RWE into its alliance with Veba.
The Financial Times report said Cable and Wireless of the UK was holding up the conclusion of the proposed German joint venture and might be preparing to abandon the alliance altogether.
A Cable and Wireless spokeswoman declined to comment in detail on the FT report but added "We are working with Veba and RWE to bring RWE into the alliance."
Cable and Wireless linked up with Veba in 1995 and drew up an agreement on RWE's entry into the market two weeks ago but has not yet signed the contract.
The Financial Times said negotiations on terms had been reopened and said that executives close to the German utility company believed Cable and Wireless was changing its international strategy.
